Remember, a pit stop normally takes about two and a half seconds, so he is not losing much. Behind them, the fight for the podium is getting serious: the car in fourth place is overtaking on the outside, into turn one, and that is a brave move. One driver has already retired this afternoon with an engine problem.

Good afternoon and welcome to our preview of Sunday. Qualifying finished an hour ago and the grid is now set. The driver on pole position starts from the clean side of the track, which usually matters more here than anywhere else. The teams are checking the weather every ten minutes, because rain is arriving from the west. Most of them are planning one stop, but if it rains they change everything. We are back at one o'clock with the build-up to the race.

First, qualifying on Saturday decides the grid for Sunday. Then the driver on pole position leads the field into the first corner. After that, the cars come into the pits and the teams change the tyres. Next, one car overtakes on the outside and takes second place. Finally, one driver retires with an engine problem and the top three go to the podium.
